SEPTEMBER 20-23 
 
Interview Experience (INTERNSHIP) 
─ 
Vishwas Hibare – BTECH CSE 
Eligibility Criteria 
CGPA: 7+ 
Stipend: 75000/month 
Location: Pune/Chennai 
PPO : 18LPA CTC 
 
ABOUT CITI… 
Citibank is the consumer division of financial services multinational Citigroup. Citibank was 
founded in 1812 as the City Bank of New York and later became the First National City Bank 
of New York. Citibank provides credit cards, mortgages, personal loans, commercial loans, 
and lines of credit. Website: https://www.citigroup.com/global

1 
 
Timeline…. 
PPT : 6th September 
Online test : 11th September 
Technical Interview : 14th September 
HR interview : 14th September 
Internship timeline : 29th May - 21st July 
PPO announcement : 29 july 
 
ABOUT Pre Placement talk (PPT) … 
In PPT they will provide all the details about company and CTC, Stipend also and extra 
amenities which they are providing when you join the company. My suggestion if you are 
targeting the CITI CORP then you must have the knowledge of CITI , because in HR round 
they will ask the questions related to CITI so do attend the PPT. 
 
 ABOUT Online Test… 
The test was conducted on an AMCAT platform. The test has a total of 5 sections. You 
cannot navigate back to previous questions and also are unable to switch between sections 
1. CS subjects’ based MCQs (25 Questions in 35 minutes) MCQs based on stacks, 
queues, trees, searching, sorting techniques, PTOs, basic programming questions, 
OOPS, etc 
2. Aptitude (16 Questions in 16 minutes) MCQs on topics like work and time, 
probability, permutations and combinations, percentages, ages, profit, loss, etc. The 
only thing is you need to be fast. 
3. Logical Reasoning (14 Questions in 14 minutes) I don’t clearly remember the 
questions in this section. 
4. Verbal Reasoning (22 Questions in 18 minutes) Antonyms, synonyms, prepositions, 
passages, etc. The questions were easy. It is better to read the passages thoroughly.  
5. Coding section (2 questions in 1 hour) 
          1) The first question is related to this question 
https://leetcode.com/problems/gray-code/description/ 
           2) I don’t remember the second question

2 
 
A total of 76 students were shortlisted for Interviews. 
 
Technical Interview (30 mins) 
1) First of all I want to say CITI’s interview is always easy for interns ,first interviewer told me 
to give the introduction .after that he asked me simple coding question to print the 
Fibonacci series , I coded by simple recursion after that he told me to optimize it I used the 
DP approach , and he also asked me the TC and SC of it , My suggestion explain everything 
to the interviewer always talk don’t keep mum even while writing the code try comminating 
with the interviewer in short whatever you think try to speak it and conversate with the 
interviewer it creates impression , even explain small things like I also explained him what 
is iostream , using namespace std .  
2) Second part of the interview, I have done my projects in app dev (flutter) so he asked me 
what is flutter ,what is firebase how it works , difference between authentication and 
authorization, sorry I remember this much only  but questions were easy My suggestion if 
its possible to know who is your interviewer check him/her on LinkedIn and check his/her 
specialization  so that u can get the idea what he can ask , prepare for that and CITI need 
java and web developer (just for information) if you have prepared for this you will get 
more privilege.   
 
I was selected in the next round along with 31 students 
 
HR Interview (30 mins) 
My HR interview was very good and took more time. I gave my introduction , I had 
mentioned about the inheritance project in my resume and also I was the leader so he 
started asking question on it that 
1. How did you managed to be the leader  
2. If your 2 teammate come with an  idea for the same issue then how did you manage 
to take one idea without hurting the another one

3 
 
3. He gave me real life scenario if you and my collogue both came with the one 
solution but your solution is correct then how will I convince my collogue that how 
he is wrong or how his solution is not suitable without dominating  
4. He also asked various question about CITI ,so read the info of CITI 
5. Asked about hobbies ,what places did you visit in Mumbai 
6. Why do you want CITI  
In short he asked me every typical HR question so prepare for that My suggestion be 
confident be loud, prepare well for HR questions be honest and if interviewer tell you to 
ask any question always ask the question and it should be good, don’t try to hurt the 
interviewer in any aspects because it comes to ego of the interviewer then chances of 
getting selected becomes low, if you don’t know the answer honestly tell him, it doesn’t 
matter even if u couldn’t answer 2 or 3 questions.        
 
A list of 15 selected candidates came at 11 at night and I was very happy to see my name 
on that list. 
Final Thoughts and Internship experience 
CITI is good company even you get promotion and increment of more than 10% in your 
base pay after just 1 year so it is a good start, I explored everything at CITI corporate life, 
projects, domains, work life balance everything was good , you will get multiple 
opportunities to work on various new tech stacks , I worked on python, object 
detection(YOLOv7), text extraction(TesseractOCR) and also CITI has done the training for 
data analysis by tableau. By myself I learnt spring boot many devops terms, unit testing  
throughout my internship Finally I want to say it was very nice experience not a single 
negative term that I can mention. 
 
    
References 
Reference are the same like others…

4 
 
Tips… 
1. Prepare well try to attend multiple interviews (regardless of interview level) you will 
get experience. 
2. Study hard, If you get internship you can get the PPO so it creates multiple offers for 
you and get placed early  
3. So all the best , remember internships are important it increases the value of your 
resume. Feel free to ask any doubt to me..
